NEOW.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0.char: You called for a physician. I fear you are beyond my care.
NEOW.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.2-1.char: Something that survives long enough to spread.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0: A structure this old should have collapsed from infection long ago.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-1: Stone remembers every sickness carried across it.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-a: Then let me open the wound.
DARV.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0r.char: You look remarkably healthy. I distrust that.
DARV.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-1r.ancient: Health is only the interval between symptoms.
PAEL.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0r.char: I have treated fevers kinder than this place.
PAEL.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-1r.ancient: Kindness has never cured the Spire.
TANX.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0r.char: Another collector. Tell me what disease you prize most.
TANX.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-1r.ancient: The one that teaches its host to endure.
VAKUU.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0r.char: The air around you is sterile. Unnaturally so.
VAKUU.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-1r.ancien: Purity is merely another kind of poison.
OROBAS.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0r.char: I can smell old blood beneath the incense.
OROBAS.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-1r.ancie: And I can smell the graves behind your mask.
NONUPEIPE.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0r.ch: Do not mistake the mask for fear of contagion.
NONUPEIPE.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-1r.an: No. It is fear of recognition.
TEZCATARA.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-0r.ch: Your symptoms are fascinating. Terminal, but fascinating.
TEZCATARA.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-1r.an: You speak as though you are not infected too.
TEZCATARA.talk.PB-PLAGUE_BRINGER.0-attac: Every physician is eventually a patient.
